scope: Targeted primary-source search for two human-interaction candidates; not systematic, not reproduction. Search families: CoCreatAR; XR uncertainty decision calibration; historical VR authenticity; remote XR quality inspection; monoscopic versus stereoscopic spatial decisions.

sources.citation: Numan, N., Brostow, G., Park, S., Julier, S., Steed, A., & Van Brummelen, J. (2025). CoCreatAR: Enhancing Authoring of Outdoor Augmented Reality Experiences Through Asymmetric Collaboration. CHI '25, 22 pages.
sources.status_version: Peer-reviewed CHI paper; unnumbered author manuscript, personal use/no redistribution notice. This is foundation R07 deepened, not a new unique paper.
sources.reading: Deep selected sections 3, 5.1-5.5, 6.1, 7.4-7.5, 8; PDF pp.4,9-13,18-19. Web extracted full text. Figure8 caption/procedure read; no successful visual QA claimed.
sources.methods_evaluation: Formative n=25; interviews n=5. Exploratory 16 pairs, within-subject counterbalanced sync/async and two outdoor sites. Seven seeded issues/site with clues. NASA-TLX, UES-SF, custom confidence, interviews; mixed-effects models.
sources.finding: Synchronous collaboration improved self-reported engagement/confidence; objective authored-quality metrics proposed as future work.
sources.limitations: Small sample, site variation, novelty bias; synchronous communication and spatial features bundled.
sources.artifacts_access: Public author PDF and supplementary-material references; code availability not verified; no execution.

sources.citation: Hullman, J., Resnick, P., & Adar, E. (2015). Hypothetical Outcome Plots Outperform Error Bars and Violin Plots for Inferences about Reliability of Variable Ordering. PLOS ONE, 10(11), e0142444.
sources.status_version: Peer-reviewed publisher full HTML, 2015 version; no later-version comparison.
sources.reading: Deep selected Methods 3.2-3.5, conclusion and supporting-information links; HTML, not PDF page claims.
sources.methods_evaluation: 288 MTurk participants, 96/encoding; power analysis. Matched draws generate HOPs, violin plots, error bars; univariate and multivariate probability estimates, including correlated variables.
sources.finding: HOPs improved multivariate judgments; high-variance univariate means can suffer.
sources.limitations: Abstract graphical probability tasks; not XR or operational decision utility.
sources.artifacts_access: S4 interface/stimuli code and S5 anonymized responses linked; not downloaded/executed.
